name: SOC 2 Basic
description: Minimum evidence for a basic SOC 2 security review. Requires a SOC 2 Type II report and a penetration test from the last 12 months, and asks for the information security policy.

requirements.name: A SOC 2 Type II report covers the last 12 months
A penetration test was performed in the last 12 months
An information security policy is in place
requirements.description: Current version, approved by management and reviewed at least annually
